about_the_game:
A New Town, A New Bold Journey:

                                              Will You Fill Your Deepest Fantasies.

This demo includes ONLY the complete Prologue chapter of BullTales.

Demo Content:

- Full prologue chapter (approximately 30-60 minutes of gameplay)

- Introduction to main characters and storyline

- Multiple choice dialogue system

- Save functionality to transfer progress to full game

The full game includes:

- Prologue + 5 complete episodes

- Extended storylines and character development

- Additional romance paths and endings

- All CG artwork and scenes

Welcome to BullTales 🐂 — the explosive sequel that thrusts you into a world of raw dominance and sizzling seduction. In this bold new chapter, a fresh twist on cuckold/NTR fantasies meets meticulously curated bisexual encounters.

  • Commanding Relationship Dynamics ❤️: Engage in audacious, intricate encounters that challenge your authority and ignite unbridled passion. Break barriers, seize control, and let every moment fuel your insatiable hunger for conquest.

  • Electrifying Visuals ❤️: Revel in hand-drawn artwork that vividly captures every seductive detail. From pulse-raising exchanges to intimate, heart-thumping moments, each visual is a masterclass in erotic artistry.

  • Inclusive and Diverse Encounters ❤️: With thoughtfully integrated bisexual scenes, Bulltales celebrates the full spectrum of lust and longing, delivering an experience that's as inclusive as it is irresistibly provocative.

content_descriptors.notes:

  Sexual Content:

  • Detailed sexual dialogue and erotic scenes
  • Visual novel-style adult CG artwork

  Mature Themes:
  • Infidelity and relationship conflicts
  • Sexual relationships between multiple characters
  • Adult language and suggestive dialogue throughout

  All characters depicted in sexual situations are explicitly stated to be 18 years or older. Sexual content is integrated into the story and cannot be disabled. This
  game is not suitable for children or those uncomfortable with explicit sexual content.
